test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My secretary is disposed of / discuss everything in great detail / before she begins / the actual work.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect phrase "**disposed of**".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**disposed to**" to indicate a tendency or inclination.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My secretary is disposed to discuss everything in great detail before she begins the actual work."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "discuss everything in great detail"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "before she begins"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "the actual work"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
